title: Reliable Characteristics
text: A good characteristic for a key should be constant - it doesn't change based on age, season, diet, or environment. Structural features are usually more reliable than colors or behaviors.

title: Evaluating Options
text: Color can vary within species. Size changes as organisms grow. Location is not a defining characteristic. But the presence or absence of a backbone is a fundamental, unchanging structural feature that clearly divides vertebrates from invertebrates.
